image.title: Image Capture Guidelines
image.subtitle: Up to 2 images can be uploaded per session. Both are processed together to generate a single result.

sections.heading: Image 1 — Pole Image
tips: Capture the complete pole from ground level to the very top.
Stand directly in front — straight-on view gives the best detection.
Ensure the image is sharp and non-blurry.

sections.heading: Image 2 — Pole Text Image
tips: Upload only if black painted text is visible on the pole.
Frame the shot to capture only the text region.
Keep the text clear, fully visible, and well-lit.

video.title: Video Survey Guidelines
video.subtitle: Follow these guidelines while recording to ensure accurate pole detection across all frames.

sections.heading: Camera Movement
tips: Walk at a steady, medium pace throughout the survey.
Avoid sudden jerks or quick turns.
Do not run — fast motion blurs frames.
Avoid standing still for extended periods.

sections.heading: Camera Direction
tips: Always capture poles from the front — face the pole directly.
Walk in a straight inspection path along the pole line.
Keep the pole near the center of the frame at all times.
Ensure all pole components (crossarms, insulators) remain visible.
